reflections.summary: Lost because preview of Dragonite+Rotom-Mow is hard-walled by Whimsicott: Dragonite Dragon Claw is immune vs Fairy, Rotom Thunderbolt resisted and weak to Tsareena Triple Axel (3x super effective) and Basculegion Last Respects. Prankster Tailwind won speed, then Encore locked Dragonite into useless DClaw while Rotom died to failed double-Protect + Last Respects. Sneasler/Garchomp were already gone early vs Delphox-Mega, leaving no Fairy answer.
reflections.adjustment: Next game don't pair Dragonite+Rotom vs Whimsicott. Lead Sneasler Fake Out to deny Whimsicott Tailwind/Encore, keep Garchomp Rock Slide to hit Whimsicott/Delphox-Mega. If bringing Dragonite, use Tailwind T1 or ESpeed to pick Basculegion, never spam DClaw into Whimsicott slot, and stagger Protects to avoid Encore lock.
reflections.notebook: Opp tendencies: Whimsicott Sash Prankster leads, T1 Protect or Tailwind then Encore lock + Moonblast spam vs Dragons. Tsareena Protects T1 then Triple Axel to punish Rotom-Mow/Grass. Basculegion MysticWater Adaptability mid-game cleaner with Aqua Jet + Last Respects scaling after Tsareena faints. Delphox-Mega Timid early pressure (killed Sneasler/Garchomp G1). Metagross LO and Politoed Drizzle not brought G1, likely reserve vs our Garchomp/Rotom. Plan G2: need Fake Out + Rock Slide pressure into Whimsicott, Steel/Poison answer for Fairy, avoid Dragon-lock, preserve Protects.

reflections.summary: Won because Whimsicott’s Tailwind and Prankster Encore controlled the endgame, while its Dragon Claw immunity let it finish Dragonite after Basculegion removed Rotom-Mow. The chosen four and Mega Delphox were appropriate for this offensive matchup.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and Mega Evolve Delphox again if the opponent stays with this composition, but preserve Tsareena longer so Queenly Majesty and Triple Axel remain available against Dragonite and priority users.
reflections.notebook: Rotom-Mow uses Sitrus Berry, Will-O-Wisp, and repeated Protect to stall physical pressure; remove it before committing Basculegion. Dragonite is Lum Berry Multiscale with Tailwind and can become locked into Dragon Claw, making Whimsicott’s Encore plus immunity a reliable endgame plan. Sneasler’s Focus Sash activates Unburden, so aim to KO rather than merely break the sash. Repeat the Mega Delphox/Whimsicott/Tsareena/Basculegion plan into the same offensive four; pivot toward Metagross if Klefki screens or Arcanine Intimidate becomes central.
